basic_details.job_title: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Research Associate and Technical Assistant Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore)

qualification.education_qualification: Ph.D. or equivalent in Civil/Mechanical/Metallurgical/Materials/Chemical Engineering/Chemistry, ME/M.Tech/MS with 3 years research/teaching/design experience and SCI paper, First Class B.Sc./3 Years Diploma in Engineering & Technology
qualification.details: Research Associate: Ph.D. or equivalent degree in Civil/Mechanical/Metallurgical/Materials/Chemical Engineering/Chemistry, or having 3 years of research, teaching, and design and development experience after ME/M.Tech/MS in Civil/Mechanical/Metallurgical/Materials/Chemical Engineering/Chemistry with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Desirable: good knowledge of slag recycling or concrete technology and experience in the steel industry. NET/GATE qualification in the relevant area. Technical Assistant: First Class B.Sc./3 Years Diploma in Engineering & Technology. Desirable: Experience in CFTI/research labs/industry.

salary_details.research associate: Consolidated Rs. 58,000/- per month and HRA as per the funding agency
salary_details.technical assistant: Consolidated Rs. 20,000/- per month and HRA as per the funding agency

how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Indore to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Indore to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Indore Research Associate and Technical Assistant posts is 18th September 2026. Ensure you apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate and Technical Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced by IIT Indore for these positions. This includes 2 vacancies for the Research Associate role and 1 vacancy for the Technical Assistant role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: For the Research Associate position, candidates need a Ph.D. or equivalent degree in relevant engineering or chemistry fields. Alternatively, an ME/M.Tech/MS with 3 years of research experience and a SCI paper is also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Technical Assistant position offers a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000/- per month, plus HRA as per the funding agency's norms. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate and Technical Assistant posts at IIT Indore will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Performance in both stages will be considered for final selection.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Research Associate and Technical Assistant at IIT Indore are contractual in nature. This means the employment will be for a fixed term as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for the IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 can be accessed through the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What are the desirable qualifications for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications for the Research Associate include good knowledge of slag recycling or concrete technology, and experience in the steel industry. NET/GATE qualification in the relevant area is also desirable.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Madhya Pradesh apply for these jobs?
faq.answer: The notification specifies the location as Indore, Madhya Pradesh. While the official notification does not explicitly restrict applications based on domicile, candidates should check the detailed eligibility criteria in the PDF for any residency requirements.
